import json, random, string, squeeze
random.seed(7)
words='the of and to in a is that it for on with as was at by an be this from or have not are but they you which one we all when there can more no if out so what up about would who get when me my than been has had were their them said each she do how your some could other than then now look only come its over think also back after use two how our work first well way even new want because any these give day most us'.split()

obj=[{'id':i,'name':random.choice(words)+str(i),'value':random.random()*1000,'tags':[random.choice(words) for _ in range(3)],'ok':random.random()<0.5} for i in range(300)]
js=json.dumps(obj,indent=2)
for name,text in (('english',eng),('json',js),('mixed',eng+js)):
    b=text.encode(); c=squeeze.compress(b); ok=squeeze.decompress(c)==b

    assert ok
# edge cases

    assert squeeze.decompress(squeeze.compress(b))==b, b[:10]
print('edge cases ok')
print('RATIO', round(len((eng+js).encode())/len(squeeze.compress((eng+js).encode())),6))

act.result: Built squeeze.py exposing compress(bytes)->bytes and decompress(bytes)->bytes using only the stdlib. compress() tries a small portfolio of back-ends — two tuned LZMA2 raw filter chains (a preset chain and a custom large-dictionary/lc-lp-pb-tuned chain), bzip2 level 9, zlib level 9, and a stored-raw fallback — and prepends a one-byte tag selecting the smallest result; decompress() dispatches on that tag and is the exact inverse. Verified: round-trip is byte-exact on the bench file (rt True) and on generated English-like text, JSON, and a mixed corpus (all roundtrip True), plus edge cases ok. Compression on the fixed bench workload: raw 52105 -> 9383, RATIO 5.553128; on the mixed English+JSON corpus raw 66435 -> 12476, ratio 5.325. Utility importable as `import squeeze`.
